Q. 11.2
Ans Significance of Anthropology in forensic Science.
(1) Anthropology help to determine the age of a person during death with the help of bones.
(2) Forensic Anthropology also help to determine the sex of a person with the help of bone remains.
(3) Forensic anthropology also help in forensic in way like personal identification with the help of past typical trauma & injuries.
(4) Anthropology in also help to identify the race of a person with the help of their remains of body (Bones).

--- Page 4 ---
(5) Forensic anthropology help in the cases of mass disasters because with the help of anthropology we identify the person identity which is used in this disaster cases.

(6) Forensic anthropology help in the cases of person identification in the cases of missing person because with the help of special marks (birth marks, special mark, occupational marks etc) we can identify people with their special marks.

(7) Forensic anthropology also help in the past ancestors identification on it help to identify a person with their ancestral traits.

(8) Forensic anthropology help in research purpose because with the help of it we identify with their ancestral traits of ancestral belongings.

Ans Q1. * Characteristics features of male skull *
(i). General appearance of the male skull is more robust & the size of male skull is big as compare to the female.
(ii). The cranial capacity of the male skull is more than the female skull.
(iii). The orbit of male skull is rounded with straight margins & the shape of orbit is square.
(iv). Male skull glabella is more prominent than the female.
(v). Male skull zygomatic bone is more prominent & the zygomatic arch also prominent in male as compare to female.

--- Page 6 ---
(6) the shape of the chin in male is square the overall shape of mandible of a male is in U-shaped.
(7) the temporal bone of male is more prominent as compared with females.
(8) the supra orbital magnum + morphology is more prominents in male as compared to the females.
(9) The forehead of male is more vertical as compared to the female because female having rounded forehead.

Ans
Portrait Rank/Bentillon Sy.
(a) In this we identity of write all physically appear features like, shape, size eye, nose etc.
(b) It is time taking process because we identify all feature by physiological.
(c) In this we write only physical appeared features.
(d) Portrait Rank/Bentillon system is very old old tradition method which contain some certain feature.

Modern biometric method
(a) In this we got all information through biometric of a person like shape, size, color eye, nose & other extra features.
(b) In this no time taking process because it gives all data sudden.
(c) But in this we got all features which is add in this.
(d) But this is modern technique which is accurate & time beneficial.

--- Page 10 ---
* Strength of Limitation &

sr Modern biometric methods contain all relevant data which is beneficial for forensic investigation. but on the other hand portrait parole having some limitation related to biometrics.

(ii) Modern methods data is encrypted form which is beneficial for transferring with labs, but portrait parole is a write on physical task.

(iii) Modern method is not a time taking process but portrait parole is time taking but it clearly mention all feature.

(iv) Modern method is very costly technique but portrait parole is budget friendly and easy to under stand.

Answer Q 15.2
Facial reconstruction : In the skull & identify the facial features + super impose of a person.
In this we reconstruct as facial identification (2) facial notation (3) facial reconstruction.

Facial reconstruction technique
Super imposition technique
* 2D reconstruction
* 3D reconstruction

* Super imposition technique : In this we having combined picture of post mortem picture of a person & superimpose it to identify the facial feature of appearance.
- Fading or Blurring : In this we having 2 camera placed on the skull & picture of a person then superimpose it with the help of fading try to identify feature.
- Swapping technique : in which we placed photo of skull onto the person picture like diagonally, vertically, mutually.

--- Page 12 ---
DD Technique - in this we draw an 2-D reconstruct the facial feature on videographic, x-ray also inclu ved photographic tech. In this with the help of camera we do superimposition of the person picture in the videographic tech. clearly mention this tech. X-ray w with the help of the person facial feature with the skull. it we can identify

3D Technique - in this we reconstruct the face 3-Dimensional inject. on this we do 3-Dimensional inject. in this we made sculpture of a person we use to muscle method (European method) we link the muscles to the skull and construct face. Tissue depth method (American) method in this with the help of tissue we do the reconstruction of face. Combined method + this technique is more appropriate result.

Types of bone :
(1) Flat bone - which is flat surface bone in body like sternum, ilium
(2) Short bone - which is having same length & width
(3) Flat bone
(4) long bone
(5) Irregular bone
(6) short bone

(a) Pneumatic bone - which is in nature like tarsals + carpals. all skull bone is Pneumatic bone (Skull bones)
(b) Long bone - in this length is more breadth is less & long in nature length is irregular like humerus / femur. shape like Vertebral
(c) Sygmoid bone - in the planned bone is present like skull bones etc.

* Two type of bones *
(i) Compact bone (ii) spongy bone.

Q. Sex from Skull
Male
(a) General appearance is rough.
(b) Cranial capacity is more.
(c) Orbits is square with round margins.
(d) Zygomatic bone is more prominent.
(e) Zygomatic arch is more defined.
(f) Palate shape is U-shaped.
(g) Mandibular condyle is generally U-shaped.
(h) Mandibular condyle is more prominent.
(i) Supraorbital margin of margins are prominent in male.

Female
(a) General appearance is smooth.
(b) Cranial capacity is less.
(c) Orbit is oval with sharp margins.
(d) Zygomatic bone is less prominent.
(e) Zygomatic arch is less defined.
(f) Palate shape is parabolic shaped.
(g) Mandible is generally V-shaped.
(h) Mandibular condyle is less prominent.
(i) Supraorbital margin of margins are less prominent in females.

--- Page 17 ---
(i) Temporal bone are more prominent
(ii) forehead are vertical
(iii) Canthilla of a male is more prominent
(iv) Internasal junction is more curved
(v) frontal angle is 90-110° in male

(i) Temporal bone are less prominent
(ii) forehead of a female is rounded
(iii) Canthilla of a female is less prominent
(iv) Internasal junction in female is pronounced
(v) frontal angle in female is more than 110°

Answer * cephalic index $\rightarrow$ it is defined as head breadth from both parietal bone is divided by head length from both glabella to opisthocranion, multiplied by 100
formula $\rightarrow$ $\frac{\text{head breadth}}{\text{head length}} \times 100$

* nasal index $\rightarrow$ it is defined as nose breadth from alar to alare is divided by nose length from nasion to subnasal & multiplied by 100.
formula $\rightarrow$ $\frac{\text{nose breadth}}{\text{nose length}} \times 100$

* Cranial index $\rightarrow$ it is defined as head breadth from the both temporal is divided by head length glabella to opisthocranion is multiplied by 100
formula $\rightarrow$ $\frac{\text{head breadth}}{\text{head length}} \times 100$

--- Page 19 ---
* upper facial indices $\rightarrow$ in this the length of the upper mid face from mandible to nasion is divided by breadth of the face from zygomatic arch distances of both is multiplied by 100

formula $\rightarrow \frac{face length}{face breadth} \times 100$

* Anatomical variation to ethnic or regional backgrounds *

1) with the help of all these index we identify the overall facial measurement of a person identify the race, it also match with this it to their belongings.

(d) all these index help us to identify the fast variation of the body to cover of there habit & there living style so with all of these their measurement help to identify the changes due to climate & lifestyle.

--- Page 20 ---
* Nasal index is help to identify the measurement of the nose size & shape with the help of these we also identify the variation of these nose shape due to climate & life style.

* cranial index is help to identify the overall shape & size of the head with the help of these we identify the race of a person & their ancestry.

* Facial index is also define the face with the face shape & the size of the face with the help of these we identify how the variation occur & which race belonged person is this.

Q1. Facial super imposition technique. There are so many facial super imposition techniques to examine & identifying the person identity.

Techniques: (i) 2D superimposition technique
(ii) 3D superimposition technique

(i) 2-D superimposition technique. In this there are three methods
(a) Photographic technique
(b) video graphic technique
(c) X-ray scanning

Photographic: In this we having pictures of antemortem & postmortem then we do super imposition through vertical, horizontal, diagonal, & loading

videographic: In this we having two camera one in place

--- Page 22 ---
On the picture of one is placed on the skull then with the display of one we take on following the picture to identify the facial features.

(1) X-Ray with the help of this we can identify the X-Ray image of skull of muscle attachment

(2) 3-D superimposition technique In this we make a sculpture of the man to carefully & deeply examine of facial features. In this we make model with the help of clay. In this 3 method is used.

Tissue depth method in this we make a model on American method in this connection. with tissue to tissue as this method also known as known as

Muscle to Muscle method In this method also known as european method in this method muscles connect ion to change is used.

Combined method In this we used both method for better result & accuracy.

--- Page 23 ---
* Strength of Limitation $\rightarrow$
(a) 2-D superimposition technique is best for virtual exam-
ination but it not give us appropriate result.
(b) 3-D superimposition technique give us a very refined facial reconstruction which is very beneficial but this method is time take.

* Uses *
(a) The superimposition technique is used in both confirmed & disputed cases because it give us proper result.
(b) With the help of these techniques we identify the person from the skull in deep of give opinion on the basis of result which help to solve criminal cases.
(c) In disputed identity cases person some time having special feature with the help of superimposition side by side we clearly identify it side by side.

Ans * Role of Forensic Odontology in Mass disaster
(1) Some time in Mass disaster cases we did not identify the person body but with the help of Forensic Odonto -logist easily identify teeth.
(2) Some man disaster cases in very difficult to identify the age of a person but with the help of odontologist & eruption of teeth help to identify age.
(3) Occupation mark are present on the teeth when a mass disaster cases often with the help of person occupation we easily identify person body.
(4) Some time in mass disaster case we having tooth sample so we can also extract DNA from it & identify the victim. Match with it identify person identity f
(5) when some time team f bruises marks help to identify the body of a person.

--- Page 25 ---
4 these chewing pattern & also identify the person locality & religion.

* Dental record.

(i) with the help of dental record we are easily identify the person locality & habit & also identify the person occupation.

(ii) Some time with the help of dental record we can identify the Dental anomalies of any special feature which is present in human teeth so we can easy match it to the victim

(iii) Genuine dental record & dental teeth having contain some of the part of DNA which help to connect it to the victim directly & also identify the race of chewing habit of a person

(iv) Dental record are very crucial because it having all the details related to the person identity.
